{{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Grass| type2=Poison| trainername=Nando| pokemonname=Roserade| jtrainername=ナオシ| jpokemonname=ロズレイド| tmtrainername=Naoshi| tmpokemonname=Roserade| image=[[File:Nando Roserade.png|250px]] | caption=Nando's Roserade | evolution=2| epnum=DP004| epname=Dawn Of A New Era!| location=[[Sinnoh]]| numeps1=less than 1| firststagename=Budew| numeps2=between 45 and 172| secondstagename=Roselia| firstevoep=DP004| firstevoname=Dawn Of A New Era!| secondevoep=DP176| secondevonametiming=Prior to| secondevoname=Coming Full-Festival Circle!| prevonum=406| evo1num=315| evo2num=407| current=[[Party|With Nando]]| enva1=[[Sarah Natochenny]]| enva2=[[Sarah Natochenny]]| enva3=[[Sarah Natochenny]]| java1=[[Tomoko Kawakami]]| java2=[[Tomoko Kawakami]]| java3=[[Satsuki Yukino]]| }} '''Nando's Roserade''' (Japanese: '''ナオシのロズレイド''' ''Naoshi's Roserade'') is the first {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} shown under [[Nando]]'s ownership. ==History== [[File:Nando and Roserade.png|thumb|250px|left|Roserade and Nando]] Roserade first appeared as Budew in ''[[DP004|Dawn Of A New Era!]]'' performing a {{m|Sunny Day}}, which stopped {{Ash}} and {{an|Dawn}} from fighting. Nando appeared with his harp and told the group that the Budew was his. He battled Dawn with Budew while Dawn used her {{TP|Dawn|Piplup}}, despite Piplup having a type disadvantage. As Piplup was about to use {{m|Peck}} on the Bud Pokémon, Budew dodged and covered itself up with {{m|Bullet Seed|smoke}}. Piplup then used {{m|Bubble Beam}} to make the smoke disappear but was proven ineffective against Budew. Budew began to use {{m|Solar Beam}} and as Piplup was about to use Peck for a second time, Budew's Solar Beam made contact and took out Piplup. Later, Budew battled {{TRT}} as {{TP|James|Carnivine}} was about to attack Piplup and took Carnivine out in one hit. The next morning, Budew battled [[Ash's Pikachu]] and used some healing moves to avoid losing energy. It evolved into Roselia during the middle of their battle. However, despite the Evolution, it lost to Pikachu as he dodged Roselia's Solar Beam. In ''[[DP036|A Secret Sphere of Influence!]]'', Roselia was at the [[Eterna Historical Museum]]. Prior to the events of the episode, it had a Gym battle with [[Gardenia]]'s {{p|Turtwig}} and won. Nando was taken in along with Roselia for some questioning. Around the end of the episode, Nando was proven innocent. In ''[[DP049|Dawn's Early Night!]]'', it teamed up with {{TP|Nando|Kricketune}} in the Battle Stage of the [[Hearthome City]] [[Pokémon Contest]], which was held under the [[Double Performance]] format. They battled [[Jessie's Seviper]] and {{TP|Jessie|Dustox}} and won. During Nando's long absence, Roselia [[Evolution|evolved]] into Roserade. In ''[[DP176|Coming Full-Festival Circle!]]'', it was sent out along with Nando's other {{type|Grass}} Pokémon, Sunflora, during the [[Contest Battle|Battle Stage]] of the [[Sinnoh Grand Festival]]. It was able to get Nando past the top 8. In ''[[DP183|League Unleashed!]]'', Nando sent Roserade out as his first Pokémon during his match against Ash in the [[Lily of the Valley Conference]]. It went up against [[Ash's Staraptor]]. During the battle, Roserade's {{m|Sweet Scent}} caused Staraptor to become temporarily immobile, which the Bouquet Pokémon followed up with {{m|Magical Leaf}} which scored a direct hit on Staraptor. Roserade then tried to finish off Staraptor with Solar Beam. Just when things were about to get bad for Ash, Staraptor got up and dodged at the last second. Staraptor finished Roserade off using its wild-card technique, {{m|Brave Bird}}. ==Personality and characteristics== Roserade appears to be one of [[Nando]]'s signature Pokémon, along with his {{TP|Nando|Kricketune}}. It has shown to be in sync with its {{pkmn|Trainer}}, listening closely to his commands. Although it does not know any [[sound-based move]]s like most of its [[Party|teammates]], it is a calm and poised Pokémon, which fits Nando's personality. Since Nando collects both [[Ribbon]]s and [[Badge]]s, Roserade has been used in both {{pkmn|battle|standard battling}} and [[Contest Battle]]s. Having experience from and being skilled at these two fields makes it a versatile Pokémon overall. It has also proved successful when battling with a partner in [[Double Battle|two-on-two battles]], as shown during the {{ci|Hearthome}} {{pkmn|Contest}}, which followed the [[Double Performance]] format. During the event, Roserade battled alongside Kricketune to earn Nando the coveted Hearthome Ribbon, his second Ribbon overall. ==Appearance== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{grass color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{grass color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{poison color light}}; {{roundytl|5px}}" | As a Budew ! style="background:#{{poison color light}}; {{roundytr|5px}}" | As a Roselia |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Nando Budew.png|200px]] | [[File:Nando Roselia.png|200px]] |} ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|grass|poison|Nando Roserade {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=SolarBeam|1=Sweet Scent|2=Magical Leaf}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Solar Beam|1=Sweet Scent|2=Magical Leaf}}|image2=Nando {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Roselia Sunny Day|1=Budew Mega Drain|2=Budew Bullet Seed|3=Budew Solar Beam|4=Roselia Solar Beam}}.png|caption2=Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Sunny Day
